units.source_text: 山路从隧道出口开始，沿着崖边围上了一道刷成白色的栏杆，像一道闪电似的延伸过去。

en.t: The mountain road began at the tunnel exit, where a white-painted railing ran along the edge of the cliff, stretching ahead like a streak of lightning.

units.source_text: 极目展望，山麓如同一副模型，从这里可以窥见艺人们的倩影。

en.t: Looking as far as the eye could see, the foot of the mountain looked like a model, and from here I could catch sight of the performers.

units.source_text: 走了不到七百米，我追上了她们一行。

en.t: After walking less than seven hundred meters, I caught up with their party.

units.source_text: 但我不好忽然放慢脚步，便佯装冷漠的样子，赶过了她们。

en.t: But I could not very well slow down all at once, so I pretended to be indifferent and walked past them.

units.source_text: 独自走在前头二十米远的汉子一看见我，就停住了步子。

en.t: The man who was walking alone about twenty meters ahead stopped as soon as he saw me.
